stories.title: Calls to end term-time only pay for school support staff backed in Senedd
stories.summary: Calls for a new negotiating body for school support staff, and an end to term-time only pay, has been backed in the Senedd. stories.summary: Young people in Flintshire are being offered a free vaccine against meningococcal B disease ahead of the new academic year. stories.summary: Residents with communal heating for their properties in Flintshire will see their bills fall by up to 63% from August. stories.title: Nursing union urges Welsh Government to publish corridor care data
stories.summary: The Royal College of Nursing in Wales is calling on the Welsh Government to publish monthly corridor care figures for every health board, after England’s first national data was released. Corridor care refers to patients being treated in corridors, chairs and other spaces not designed for clinical care because of pressure on hospitals. RCN Wales
